texts.li: [loan,!late,!lowtech] The loan has come due. {ENEMY} are on the comms, very politely, about the {COUNT} silver the colony owes them. Everything it landed with was bought with their money, and they would like it back.

[loan,!late,lowtech] A rider of {ENEMY} has come to the gate with a ledger under one arm. The colony's debt of {COUNT} silver is due, and the rider would like it paid. {ENEMY} are polite about these things, the first time.
[loan,late,!lowtech] {ENEMY} are back on the comms about the debt, now {COUNT} silver with their interest. They're noticeably less polite this time.
[loan,late,lowtech] The rider of {ENEMY} is back at the gate, with the ledger open at the colony's page. Owed, with interest: {COUNT} silver. The rider has stopped smiling.

[heist,boss,!late,!lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} has found the colony, and the message is short. "{COUNT} silver. Mine. Every coin of it back, and I might call it square. Otherwise I come and take it."

[heist,boss,!late,lowtech] A rider in the colors of {ENEMY} brings word from {X_nameDef}, who knows exactly where {X_possessive} {COUNT} silver went. {X_nameDef} wants all of it back, and might call it square then. Otherwise {X_nameDef} will come and take it.

[heist,!boss] The {COUNT} silver the colony is carrying was taken from one of {ENEMY}'s own, and {ENEMY} want every coin of it back. Pay, they say, and they might call it square. Don't, and they'll come and take it.
[heist,boss,late] {X_nameDef} is back for the rest of the money, {COUNT} silver of it now, interest included. The message ends: "I've been patient. Ask anyone. I'm known for it."

li.label: Pay the {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The silver is counted out for {ENEMY}'s collector, every coin, and the debt is settled at last.

li.label: Pay half now and ask for more time
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} hands over half the silver and a great many promises. {ENEMY} agree to wait. The rest will cost more when they come back for it.

li.label: Refuse to pay
li.outcome: No silver goes out. {ENEMY} will come for what they're owed within a day or so, and they'll keep coming.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their money
li.text: The colony wouldn't pay what it owes {ENEMY}. They've come to take it.
